title: To the Sky!
content:
Bird’s Eye View! Sometimes, just try to look at your world from a thousand feet above. You are so small, so tiny, so puny! And you live in your own small, tiny and puny space.
Stretch out your wings when you can, try to see more than what is just shown to you, the world is infinite, and our life is just an instant, which will get over before we know it, unless, we just GO FOR IT!!!
:)

P.S.: I loved the movie, and I loved the song! Watch it and Enjoy it!! :D
